name: Garfiel Tinsel
japaneseName: ガーフィール・ティンゼル
description: Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and the fierce military officer of the Emilia Camp. The younger half-brother of Frederica Baumann and a powerful Beast Human hybrid, he was initially an antagonist during the first half of Arc 4 before joining Subaru's side, becoming a crucial powerhouse throughout Arcs 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, and 10.
